findings.explanation: Only the client has the right to terminate the agreement without cause, while you do not have a corresponding right.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause upon providing at least thirty (30) days prior written notice to the other party.

findings.quoted_text: 5. 4    The REVENUE SHARE FEE shall be payable quarterly in arrears 45 days after the end of each quarter for the duration of this AGREEMENT.
findings.explanation: Payment terms of 45 days exceed the standard 30-day threshold, delaying your receipt of revenue.
findings.suggested_change: The REVENUE SHARE FEE shall be payable quarterly in arrears within 30 days after the end of each quarter for the duration of this AGREEMENT.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are doing well. I am reviewing the agreement and have one small point to discuss before signing: - In the relevant clause, the 45-day payment timeline delays the receipt of the revenue share fee, and I propose modifying this so that payment is due within 30 days after the end of each quarter. Thank you, and I look forward to moving forward.
